primary_metric_definition: For each row, average squared error over 323 standardized targets; average row MSE within participant; take participant RMSE; average participants.
eligibility: converged configurations only when at least one converged configuration exists
extra_trees: five-seed prediction ensemble for configuration selection
boundary_rule: Flag a boundary winner for review, but do not expand any grid after observing validation results.
final_lock: Selected configurations are candidates only. A later explicit lock is required before refit train+validation and one-time test opening.
